clauses.requirement: Conformity of production (UN R150 para 3.5, procedures per 1958 Agreement Schedule 1, E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3): any retro-reflective marking plates approved to this Regulation shall be manufactured to conform to the approved type by meeting the requirements of paragraphs 4. and 5.; for resistance to external agents, only paragraph 5.7.6.1. applies.
For retro-reflective marking plates, the minimum requirements for conformity of production control procedures set forth in Annex 2 to UN R150 shall be complied with.
For retro-reflective marking plates, the minimum requirements for sampling by an inspector set forth in Annex 3 to UN R150 shall be complied with.

The type approval authority may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production facility for retro-reflective marking plates; the normal frequency of these verifications shall be once every two years.
Administrative provisions: penalties for non-conformity of production shall apply as set out in paragraph 3.6 of UN R150 (sub-paragraphs 3.6.1 and 3.6.2).
The approval granted may be withdrawn if the requirements of UN R150 are not met.

If a Contracting Party to the 1958 Agreement applying UN R150 withdraws a previously granted approval, it shall forthwith notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1.

If the approval holder completely ceases to manufacture a retro-reflective device approved under UN R150, he shall inform the approving authority; upon receiving the communication, that authority shall inform the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1.
